title: Quantitative and Qualitative Analysis
description: Address the techniques commonly used in the analysis of both quantitative and qualitative data. Understand a range of statistics commonly used in nursing research and learn how they are used in a computer-based application. Understand how qualitative data is used in nursing research and engage in the process of coding qualitative data through coding and thematic construction.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of NURS 425, HSD 425.
All students must have basic computing and word processing skills prior to enrolling in the course.
